user_request: Read the following part request and produce a build123d script that models the part. The request is: 'Create an L-bracket with overall dimensions 40 mm long, 20 mm wide, and 10 mm tall. The bracket has a vertical leg 10 mm thick and a horizontal base 10 mm thick. There are two M4 clearance holes, one in the vertical leg and one in the horizontal base, each centered 10 mm from the nearest edges.'
